g.title: Refiner
g.text: Where custom refiner weights would fit
Proposed design only · Ojin's architecture and checkpoint remain unavailable

g.title: cluster_runtime
g.text: RUNTIME INSERTION | proposed; no training at inference

g.title: targets
g.text: Correct teeth, lip geometry and timing

g.title: train
g.text: Compare with clean target + temporal / boundary losses

g.title: infer
g.text: Instantiate OUR architecture, load OUR checkpoint
Run fixed weights on each crop

g.title: compiled
g.text: Compiled network + trained weights + device tactics
.engine accelerates evaluation; does not teach teeth

g.title: native
g.text: Regular motion feedback AND sent-frame reconditioning
Must remain separate from refined display history

g.title: tracker
g.text: Existing detector has its own task weights

g.title: base
g.text: Bicubic initially; learned SR is a separate option

g.title: blend
g.text: Blend into mouth interior at delivery resolution
Preserve lips / tongue occlusions / closed mouth
No direct changes outside the chosen mask

g.title: history
g.text: Past-only context; reset on cuts or tracking loss

g.title: note
g.text: Weights = learned numbers used by network code
Activations / latent history = transient data produced for this call
Steps = repeated inference operations with the same weights
Checkpoint extension (.pt / .safetensors) does not define architecture
Ojin's refiner_weights.pt cannot be assumed compatible with OUR network
